title: Chapter 28 Witnessing The Destruction Of The Territory (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 28 Witnessing The Destruction Of The Territory (Part 2)

Wu Qing sent 20 hosts over, and through the guidance of mental power, began to guide all the fleeing people to walk in one direction.

"Please retreat in the direction of the guidance, and there will be reinforcements to cover the retreat!"

The host continued to use mental power to repeat this message, guiding the direction of retreat.

Many of the fleeing people did see the battle between the Zerg troops and the Lizardmen, and someone stood up and spoke at this time.

"There are reinforcements behind us to cover the retreat! Let's change our plans and follow the guidance!"

"You can't run away like this! Take a gamble! Follow us!"

"Go! Keep up with the main force!"

"..."

More and more people followed the host's guidance and walked in one direction. Of course, there were also people who were smart and chose other directions.

Wu Qing wanted the general trend, and he didn't care about the details.

The retreat direction guided by the host was not directly to the direction of Daxia Territory. Wu Qing would lead these people to Daxia Territory only when he was sure that he could stop the enemy's pursuit.

Otherwise, leaving a tail and letting the enemy chase to Daxia Territory would be very bad.

Soon, the lizardmen in charge of the pursuit were wiped out by the Zerg troops. The Zerg troops suffered minimal losses, and the combat power of this servant race was indeed much worse.

The escape route was reopened, which gave more people the opportunity to escape from the city.

The crowds at the various city gates kept pouring out, indicating that the battle situation in the city was becoming increasingly pessimistic, and it was only a matter of time before the entire city was completely captured.

The lizardmen in charge of the pursuit and interception found that the escape hole for the residents in the city was not blocked, so they withdrew a group of lizardmen from the front battlefield, bypassed the city, and continued to intercept.

Based on the intelligence provided by the lurking puppy, the Zerg troops drilled into the underground and ambushed on the road that the lizardmen had to pass.

When the lizardmen army entered the ambush circle, they suddenly drilled out from the ground and launched a fierce attack on the lizardmen.

The strength of the two sides was similar, and the individual strength of the Zerg was stronger, and they took advantage of the ambush, and the lizardmen collapsed in one fell swoop.

But the lizardmen are also fanatical believers of the spirit god, and they also have the spirit of fighting to the death.

Both sides fought for their lives, and this battle became a war of annihilation and attrition.

With the resources obtained on the battlefield, Wu Qing did not plan to let the dogs he sent out go back. All the dogs that burst out of the Zerg base rushed to a location in the predetermined evacuation direction to assemble.

The interception troops sent out twice did not work. The commander of the lizardmen finally realized that something was wrong. He reported the situation to the priest of the bear goblin who was responsible for commanding this war.

Now the battlefield situation is progressing steadily and victory is in sight. The priest of the bear goblin does not want to cause trouble. He wants to capture the city first and then talk about other things.

It doesn't matter to him if some people run away.

In this way, Wu Qing did not wait for the reinforcements of the lizardmen, but the battle situation in the city became more intense.

Wu Qing did not want to intervene in the battle in the city. It would be futile for the Zerg to participate in the war. It would be better to find a way to save the lives of those who escaped.

Just when nearly 10,000 people had escaped from the city, an elite force of bear goblins finally rushed from the city to the gates and cut off the escape route.

The elite bear goblin troops killed people at the gates and successfully closed the city gates again. The city and the outside of the city became two different worlds.

"The people behind can't get out! Quickly follow the main force to retreat!"

"We have reinforcements to cover the rear!"

The news that there were troops to cover the rear was constantly spreading to the crowd behind.

The host's guidance continued, and the people who escaped from the city gradually gathered, forming a long dragon according to the guidance, and quickly extended to the distance.

As the crowd gradually went away, the main force of the Zerg also left the city, leaving only a small number of puppies to lurk and observe.

Not long after, the city gates opened again, and this time it was the army of bear goblins and lizardmen who came out in a line.

Perhaps the situation in the city has stabilized. For the bear goblins, the biggest benefit has been obtained. If they can capture some of these people who escaped to convert to the gods, it will be an extra gain.

The troops leaving the city continued. Wu Qing carefully counted through the lurking puppy that there were about 2,000 bear goblin soldiers and about 3,000 lizardmen soldiers, totaling 5,000 pursuit troops.

From the number of pursuit troops, it can be seen that the bear goblin side has an absolute advantage in terms of military strength. The Tengu tribe on the side defending the city occupied the city defense advantage and held on for some time.

Once the city wall was broken, they were defeated and had no time to react.

Such a large city has a population of at least 100,000 people, and now less than 10,000 have escaped.

Others either died or were forced to become believers of foreign gods.

From what Wu Qing saw, it is not wrong to say that they have lost themselves because of such fanatical and firm beliefs.

These foreign gods are probably not serious gods. The gods in Wu Qing's mind should not be like this.

The pursuit troops were assembling, but before they set off, Wu Qing noticed that the huge luck that enveloped the city suddenly disappeared, as if it had been swallowed up by something.

This territory is destroyed!

A strange energy protected the city again.

"The lord cannot use all the luck in the territory. The remaining luck will be wasted on those gods."

"The gods are behind the believers to fight everywhere, and snatching luck should be one of the important reasons."

Wu Qing sensed the strange energy in the city through the puppy lurking at the edge of the city, and felt very uncomfortable.

"You have taken the biggest advantage, so I will take a little advantage and eat the feast you delivered to my door first."

Wu Qing looked at the pursuit troops that had set off, feeling a little unhappy.

Watching others eat meat, he could only drink a few drops of soup, which made him feel very uncomfortable.

The lizardmen in the pursuit troops were not a big problem, but the bear goblins were a bit troublesome. Fortunately, Wu Qing did not find the bear goblin priest in the team. This time, a strong bear goblin knight was leading the troops.

As long as there is no sacrifice, there will be much less trouble, and of course, the harvest will be much less.

Nearly 10,000 people lined up in a long dragon in one direction, and the traces were very obvious. The cavalry scouts of the bear goblin pursuit troops were sent out, and the large troops followed closely.

The pursuit troops were well-trained and had streamlined equipment and carrying items, so they were moving very fast.

Ordinary civilians of the native race, with their families, could not walk fast. If no one helped them intercept the pursuers, it would be a matter of time before they were caught up.

The knight who led the pursuit troops was very cautious when he knew that two teams of lizardmen soldiers were missing, otherwise he would have caught up with the fleeing team not far ahead.

The knight saw no corpses of lizardmen or enemies around, which meant that the two sides should not have fought in this area.

Perhaps there was a battle going on ahead, and they were urgently needed to go and support.

Thinking of this, he ordered to speed up the march.

They were getting farther and farther away from the city.
